item.goo.smithing_template.exorite_upgra: Add netherite armor, weapon, or tool
goo.ability.yore.rewind.description: Rewind time for a mob, freezing it while held, then turning it into a baby, or into its spawn egg if it is already a baby or has none.
goo.ability.yore.expire.description: Kills the mob struck outright. Does not work on bosses.
goo.ability.yore.ancient.description: No damage can take you below half a heart.
goo.ability.yore.age.description: Slowly ages the block the blob lands on into an older form, such as copper weathering or a coal block becoming diamond.
goo.ability.blaze.broil.description: Channel a heat stream: the block you aim at cooks in place, foliage burns away, and creatures in the stream take fire damage. Starts no fires.
goo.ability.blaze.ignite.description: Lights a fire where the blob lands. Landing on an explosive goo block sets it off as a fiery explosion.
goo.ability.blaze.kindle.description: Your hearts become ember hearts. Melee attackers take fire damage based on your embers; water quenches them, and ash hearts take double damage.
goo.ability.blaze.melt.description: Turns the natural stone the blob strikes into lava. Blocks that cannot melt cannot be targeted.
goo.ability.blaze.flames.description: Channel a cone of fire that burns and ignites every creature it touches. Held on a prism, makes a heater that flames nearby mobs.
goo.ability.crystal.cloud.description: Leaves a crystal cloud where the blob lands that shreds every moving creature inside it, sprinters more often. Sneaking keeps you safe.
goo.ability.crystal.shards.description: Charge up, then sling a fan of shards that deal magic damage to each creature they hit.
goo.ability.crystal.glitter.description: Hold to grow a sphere that finds gem ore veins out to 64 blocks, showing them through walls for a while.
goo.ability.crystal.scales.description: Crystal hearts grow over your hearts and take every hit before your health, regrowing while held.
goo.ability.crystal.prism.description: Grows a milky quartz prism where the blob lands. Other goo abilities that hit it give it a lasting combo, one per prism.
goo.ability.astral.gate.description: Opens a portal where the blob lands, leading to the lunar dimension by night or the solar dimension by day; both portals later revert to the blocks they covered.
goo.ability.astral.meteo.description: Calls a meteor down from high above onto where the blob lands, exploding on impact. The target needs a clear path to the sky.
goo.ability.astral.scry.description: Hold to send out pings, spheres of light that reveal exposed block faces and make every living thing they cross glisten, even behind walls.
goo.ability.deep.churn.description: Churns the column under where the blob lands, turning it over layer by layer so the bottom comes up and the top goes down. Drag to set the depth.
goo.ability.deep.convoke.description: Leaves a blob that pulls a mob from elsewhere in its chunk to its spot, waiting until one arrives.
goo.ability.deep.dive.description: Drops you into a random cave within 16 blocks, favoring caves below you. Does nothing if no safe cave is in reach.
goo.ability.ender.zone.description: Curses a mob so it warps away whenever it comes near a player; zoning a cursed mob again exiles it. Bosses and mobs above 100 max health are unaffected.
goo.ability.ender.blink.description: Blink up to 32 blocks along your look, through walls, landing only where you fit. Snaps to an oculus in view; blinking at a bare prism makes it an oculus.
goo.ability.ender.blink.cost_mechanics: Plus %s per block travelled and %s more through a wall; a trip to an oculus costs %s percent.
goo.ability.ender.end.description: Opens an End portal where the blob lands, linked to the End's platform; both later revert to the blocks they covered.
goo.ability.ender.shifter.description: Each hit you would take instead blinks you 8 blocks along your look.
goo.ability.quantum.phase.description: You stand out of phase: only creatures on your side of phase can hit you or be hit by you, and mobs lose you as a target.
goo.ability.quantum.phase_shift.descript: Puts a struck mob out of phase, so it can hit and target only creatures on its own side of phase.
goo.ability.quantum.hole.description: Opens a hole three blocks across and three deep into the blocks it strikes; the blocks return after a while.
goo.ability.quantum.anchor.description: Makes a prism a quantum anchor that pairs with your next one; a player standing at either anchor is carried to its partner.
goo.ability.quantum.swap.description: Leaves a swap body where you stand; casting again returns you to it and leaves a fresh one behind.
goo.ability.quantum.link.description: Links the next two mobs you strike: health lost or gained by one is mirrored to the other, and so are status effects.
goo.ability.frost.snap.description: Strikes a mob with freezing damage, filling its frozen gauge and heavily slowing it. Bosses are unaffected.
goo.ability.frost.nova.description: Charge, then release a frost ring that freezes, damages and lightly knocks back nearby mobs and puts out fire. Holding longer makes it larger and stronger.
goo.ability.frost.cold.description: Channel a cone of freezing wind that freezes and damages creatures, pushes them lightly, kills foliage and puts out fire. Held on a prism, keeps the area around it frozen.
goo.ability.frost.orb.description: Launches a slow frost orb that freezes mobs and water or lava along its path, then bursts in a frost nova, almost fully freezing mobs right beside it.
goo.ability.frost.iceborn.description: Frozen hearts take hits first but are weak to physical damage. Nearby fire goes out, water and lava freeze, and your snowballs deal ice damage. Fire ends it.
goo.ability.glow.crystal.description: Fires a beam that places a glow crystal giving off maximum light. On a prism, lights it as a beacon.
goo.ability.glow.sunbeam.description: Hold to fire a ray of light that damages and glistens mobs, burning undead harder. A combo prism splits it among nearby mobs; a bare one becomes a reflector.
goo.ability.glow.lux.description: Grants night vision without particles, and the mob you look at glistens.
goo.ability.glow.radiant.description: Hold to flood the dark air around you with fading wisps of light, out to 64 blocks.
goo.ability.hex.charm.description: Charms a mob: until you hurt it, it fights whatever targets you and follows you. High-health mobs often resist; bosses are unaffected.
goo.ability.hex.enchant.description: Turns a book into an enchanted book holding one random level-one enchantment, curses and treasure enchantments included.
goo.ability.hex.fuse.description: Fuses two identical enchanted books you carry into one a level higher, without an anvil.
goo.ability.hex.lifetap.description: Food no longer regenerates your health, but damage you deal heals you for a portion of it.
goo.ability.hex.drain.description: Channel a short, wide cone that drains the creatures in it, healing you for half the damage dealt.
goo.ability.jelly.heal.description: Channel a healing stream that heals you and every living thing in its cone.
goo.ability.jelly.gluttony.description: Your hunger and health fill over time and keep filling past their caps as overhunger and overheal.
goo.ability.jelly.reserve.description: Channel to drain health and hunger into reserve hearts and shanks behind your bars, at a loss; the reserve is spent before your real health and hunger.
goo.ability.jelly.feed.description: A struck animal counts as fed. On the ground it lays a feed that draws nearby mobs, and hostiles that reach it together fight each other.
goo.ability.leaf.barkskin.description: Bark hearts shield your hearts, regrow over time and thorn melee attackers; fire and axes deal aggravated damage through them.
goo.ability.leaf.vines.description: Roots a struck mob in vines that hold it, thorn it for straining and make fire hurt it more; a missed throw waits on the ground as a trap.
goo.ability.leaf.bloom.description: Spawns plants by chance around where the blob strikes, each one a flora that can grow on the surface it lands on.
goo.ability.leaf.growth.description: Channel a breeze that grows the plants in its cone and speeds Barkskin's regrowth. On a prism, it slowly greens nearby blocks and nudges crops.
goo.ability.leaf.reap.description: Harvests every ripe crop around where the blob strikes; a crop that would drop a seed is replanted.
goo.ability.leaf.bio.description: Inflicts a toxin that drains a share of the mob's max health over its duration. Repeat hits raise its potency up to twice and refresh the duration.
goo.ability.metal.javelin.description: Throws a blob that turns into a dart mid-flight and damages the mob it strikes.
goo.ability.metal.magnet.description: Channel an expanding sense that reveals metal ore veins through walls, ancient debris included.
goo.ability.metal.spikes.description: Throws a spike trap that impales creatures near it that are not sneaking, one at a time, until its spikes are spent.
goo.ability.nether.black_hole.descriptio: Creates a black hole that pulls everything into itself, including items, and destroys most mobs. It leaves a compression sphere holding the blocks and items it took.
goo.ability.nether.decay.description: Channel a swarm of gnats that degrades each block it reaches by one step and nips mobs. On a prism, the swarm damages mobs nearby.
goo.ability.nether.undead.description: Nether hearts fill your missing hearts and regenerate rapidly. You count as undead: harming heals you, healing harms you, and direct sunlight burns you.
goo.ability.pulse.extender.description: Your other held effects pay no upkeep on every other tick.
goo.ability.pulse.pulser.description: Channel to rapidly toggle levers, buttons, doors, trapdoors and fence gates in your aim. On a prism, it pulses at the rate its last two signals set.
goo.ability.pulse.zap.description: Ticks the redstone device it hits, or else toggles levers, doors and the like beyond it, and stuns mobs nearby. On a prism, it makes a wireless relay.
goo.ability.rock.bore.description: Channel a narrow stream that tunnels through mundane blocks in front of you and damages mobs inside the tunnel.
goo.ability.rock.flatten.description: Hold to break earth blocks, with their drops, under your cursor out from the face you started on, never past that face.
goo.ability.rock.petrify.description: Channel a fog that slowly turns mobs into stone statues and calcifies exposed blocks a step harder, such as gravel to cobblestone.
goo.ability.rock.spire.description: Drag out a rectangle of ground, set its rise with your look, and click again to lift it as a wall or platform; stone or deepslate refills the gap.
goo.ability.rock.stoneskin.description: Stone hearts fill your missing hearts. They take less physical damage but are worth only half a heart against explosions and pickaxes; your health cannot regenerate.
goo.ability.shroom.mycosis.description: Spray a cloud of spores in a direction. Infected mobs are poisoned, slowed and weakened, and burst into spores on death; nether wart and fungal buds grow.
goo.ability.shroom.colonize.description: Throw a blob of shroom goo that spreads the shroom network it lands on, or buds the ground there if it lands on none. Spores and infects mobs nearby.
goo.ability.shroom.fungal_shift.descript: While standing near a fungus, move to the fungus block you aim at.
goo.ability.shroom.sight.description: Fungal Shift reaches three times farther, and you can see fungus blocks through walls.
goo.ability.kinetic.grab.description: Lifts the mob or item you look at and holds it in front of you; look down to draw it closer, left click to throw it.
goo.ability.kinetic.telekinesis.descript: You reach blocks and entities from farther away.
goo.ability.typhoon.float.description: Inflict the mob with levitation, causing it to float.
goo.ability.typhoon.tailwind.description: You fly forward along your look. Elytra improves your air control.
goo.ability.typhoon.airborn.description: You can steer in midair and while levitating, fall slowly without fall damage, and jump higher. Tailwind is stronger and elytra glides faster.
goo.ability.typhoon.gust.description: Channel a rushing wind that pushes mobs in its cone away along your aim.
goo.ability.typhoon.updraft.description: A blob placed in the world creates a column of air that carries entities upwards.
goo.ability.unstable.buster.description: Your melee hits strike every living thing near the one you hit, and each block you break also breaks the blocks around it.
goo.ability.unstable.explode.description: Explode wherever the goo lands. Dragging a bigger throw makes a bigger blast.
goo.ability.unstable.lurker.description: A proximity mine that explodes when something living gets near. It pulses brightly as it detects creatures, before it explodes.
goo.ability.unstable.unmake.description: Destabilizing waves dismantle the blocks in front of you, turning them back into goo.
goo.ability.unstable.unmake.cost_mechani: Burns unstable goo for each block dissolved: the fuel the unstable crucible would burn melting it, plus its square root.
goo.ability.weird.magma.description: Cools nearby lava into magma blocks where the blob lands.
goo.ability.void.erase.description: Removes the mob struck from the world entirely, with no death and no drops. Does not work on bosses.
goo.ability.void.pocket.description: Opens a gate where the blob lands, leading to your own room in the pocket dimension. The gate closes after a while; the room keeps what you build.
goo.ability.weird.bounce.description: Leaves a bouncy pad where the blob lands that cancels fall damage and launches whatever lands on it back up.
goo.ability.weird.wobble.description: The mob struck deals no damage with its attacks; they only knock their target back.
goo.ability.weird.slime.description: The blob turns into a small slime where it lands.
goo.ability.xeno.eldritch.description: You can see out-of-phase mobs, warped and twisted, and they can target you.
goo.ability.zoo.allure.description: Puts the animal struck in love, if it could breed now.
goo.ability.zoo.rally.description: Peaceful creatures around you fight your enemies, with more health and speed.
goo.ability.zoo.shape.description: Turns the slime struck into a random peaceful mob that spawns in its biome.
goo.ability.zoo.spawn.description: Turns the slime struck into a random hostile mob that spawns in its biome.
goo.ability.cost_mechanics.upkeep: Costs nothing to start, then %s a second until you invoke it again or run dry.
